zh.pain: 不想把自己的东西放在别人服务器上，可现有的本地方案第一步就是让你自己搭服务——有人不是开发者，也硬着头皮自己写了一个。
zh.kill: 平台自带的记忆免费、默认开着；说服普通人自己管一个记忆库，是场硬仗。
zh.move: 做一个不用注册、不连服务器的个人记忆盒子：导入聊天记录和语音笔记，卖点只有一个——它只在你机器里。

pain: Non-developers who are fed up enough with their data living on someone else's server that they are building their own memory tools badly rather than not at all.
kill: Platform memory (ChatGPT/Claude/Google) is free, default-on and zero-effort; teaching ordinary users to own their memory store is an uphill education fight.
move: Ship a no-server, no-account personal memory vault as a consumer app, importing chat exports and voice notes; privacy is the entire pitch. Cold start: EN — the Echologue HN thread and r/PrivacyGuides; CN — 小红书'AI 日记 隐私'笔记评论区.
wallet: 弱：本地记忆这件事方圆之内几乎没有付费行为，愿意自托管的人也最不愿付钱——按 1d 应排到后面
